description: Shared Renovate policy for ShaddyDC's projects (README.md).

packageRules.description: Non-major updates merge themselves once the PR's CI passes. Renovate never automerges without passing checks, so a repo without PR CI only gets PRs.
GitHub Actions majors too: the PR's own CI runs the new action.
ghcr.io and other OCI registries publish no release timestamps; without this every update from them waits forever.
